subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should `feishu_doc` support initial `content` on `create`, or should `create` reject `content` before creating a document?
rationale: Both fixes remove the silent data loss, but they define different public tool contracts and different partial-failure behavior after a document has already been created.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Return a clear validation/tool error before document creation when `action: "create"` includes `content`, and keep `write` as the documented content path.

options.title: Create then write
options.body: Support the reporter's one-call workflow by creating the document and then calling `writeDoc`, with a response or error shape that preserves the created document id if writing fails.

options.title: Use a separate create-with-content action
options.body: Add an explicit action for initial content so the current `create` behavior stays narrow while models get a discoverable one-call workflow.

recommendation.title: Reject content on create
recommendation.body: Return a clear validation/tool error before document creation when `action: "create"` includes `content`, and keep `write` as the documented content path.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin README identifies this handle as the community owner for the Feishu/Lark plugin, making them the best available routing target for the tool contract choice.
